page_title: BAY 3-0 STU | Bayern Munich v Stuttgart 17/12/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The match has just finished.
90' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
89' Substitution. Alphonso Davies will be replaced by Frans Kratzig (Bayern Munich).
88' A cross from a corner kick by Stuttgart is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.
87' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) meets a cross inside the box, but Manuel Neuer wins the battle for the ball and the chance is gone. Stuttgart get a corner.
83' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Muller departs the field of play to be replaced by Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich).
83' Here is a change. Josha Vagnoman is going off and Sebastian Hoeness gives the last tactical orders to Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart).
83' The substitution has been made. Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) has replaced Jamal Musiala.
82' Tobias Stieler shows a yellow card to Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) for his blatant foul.
82' Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
81' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Bayern Munich will take a corner kick.

80' That didn't go as planned! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort low towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Manuel Neuer, who easily kept it out.
77' Substitution. Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) replaces Deniz Undav.
77' The current number of shots on goal is 8:1.
73' Bayern Munich fail to score from a corner as Alexander Nubel (VfB Stuttgart) leaps to collect the ball.
72' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Bayern Munich force their opponents to concede a corner.
71' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
69' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) is shown a yellow card for a late challenge.
65' Tobias Stieler blows his whistle after Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
63' 3 - 0 GOAL! The corner is whipped in and Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight into the bottom right corner. He makes it 3:0.
63' The referee awards a corner and Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) goes over to take it.
63' Wow, what an escape. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Bayern Munich are awarded a corner kick.
59' Here comes a substitution. Enzo Millot is given a rest as he is replaced by Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart).
59' Sebastian Hoeness prepares a substitution. Chris Fuhrich is replaced by Silas (VfB Stuttgart).
59' That's the end of the game for Waldemar Anton, who is replaced by Anthony Rouault (VfB Stuttgart).
58' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted.
58' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. Stuttgart will have a chance to score from a corner.
55' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds some space inside the box and scores with a terrific header inside the left post, giving the goalkeeper no chance.

55' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for an infringement. Bayern Munich win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
54' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) sprays a pass out to Thomas Muller, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball. The ball is behind the touchline and Bayern Munich will take a throw-in.
52' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+4' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Bayern Munich due to an offside in the build-up play.
45+3' Wait! Referee Tobias Stieler has indicated he is going to review the Bayern Munich goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
45+3' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!

45' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but Alexander Nubel shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
41' Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. Bayern Munich win a free kick.
40' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

37' CHANCE! Thomas Muller finds Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Stuttgart.
34' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.

32' Jamal Musiala (Bayern Munich) sends a direct shot in from the free kick that's in a promising position. The ball sails towards the right post, but the goalkeeper prevents a goal with a quick save.
32' Bayern Munich have a goal-scoring opportunity from a mid-range free kick.
31' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) was quite harsh and Tobias Stieler didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
30' The corner from Aleksandar Pavlovic (Bayern Munich) is cleared away by the defence.

29' Leroy Sane (Bayern Munich) accelerated away from the defence and took his shot early from the edge of the box. The ball flew towards the bottom right corner, but Alexander Nubel made a superb athletic save to deny him. The ball is out of play. Bayern Munich win a corner kick.
28' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) makes a slide tackle, but referee Tobias Stieler blows for a foul. Stuttgart are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
26' The goal by Bayern Munich won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
26' The Bayern Munich players halt their celebrations as referee Tobias Stieler makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

25' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) celebrates a stunning goal. He manages to win himself just enough space inside the box to meet the free kick and powers a perfectly placed header low inside the right post.
24' Dangerous play by Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart). Tobias Stieler blows his whistle for a foul. That's a free kick to Bayern Munich.
18' Manuel Neuer displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
17' Raphael Guerreiro (Bayern Munich) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.

16' Manuel Neuer makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Maximilian Mittelstadt (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.

15' What a wasted chance that was! An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich) who loops his header high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Stuttgart will have a goal kick.
14' Bayern Munich take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

14' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bayern Munich will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
13' Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
11' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Tobias Stieler stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
10' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) inside the box.
9' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.

8' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low drive is headed for the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a marvellous diving save and denies him. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Bayern Munich.
6' It looks like Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) saw red with that tackle. Tobias Stieler won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
5' Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
2' 1 - 0 Goal! Leroy Sane plays a simple square pass into the feet of Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Stuttgart will have the kick-off.
Tobias Stieler was nominated as the referee for this game.
